cues.text: You walk along a dirt path in the woods and stop. The girl from the pier stands among the trees ahead, watching you.
You step closer. She turns and walks up to you.
She steps in and throws her arms around you, holding you tight. Junpei and Akihiko come running up and stop short, staring.
Yukari and Fuuka hurry up the path toward you.
Mitsuru stands with the others. Ikutsuki, the chairman, walks up to the group.
The girl lets go of you and steps back.
